$comment: Budgets enforced by scripts/perf-audit.mjs (Lighthouse 13 no longer ships --budget-path). Scores are 0-1, metrics are milliseconds except cumulative-layout-shift, resource sizes are transferred kilobytes of the site's own resources (a third party's bytes count only as third-party requests). Initial values are regression budgets for the starter baseline; raise them only with a note in docs/performance.md. A route under `routes` takes its own values for the keys it names.

resources.$comment: Third-party requests: every page loads Google Tag Manager's container script from Google (the owner's decision, 2026-11-21; docs/architecture.md, 'Analytics'), one request, and the budget leaves room for a Google Analytics tag and its beacons once the container has one. Anything beyond that in the container is a new decision. Since 2026-11-22 the script is added at the first pointer movement, press, key, touch, or scroll, or three seconds after load, so an audit, which does none of those, may measure zero.

transferKB.$comment: The stylesheet is inlined in every page's head (astro.config.mjs, 2026-11-22), so `document` carries it and `stylesheet` reads 0; the document budget went from 40 to 80 KB for that (docs/performance.md, decision log).

/contact/.$comment: The contact page embeds Calendly's scheduler (the owner's decision, 2026-11-20; docs/architecture.md), an iframe that fetches Calendly's own scripts and styles and Stripe's, and whose cookies fail Lighthouse's third-party-cookies audit (best practices 0.77 measured). The allowances are for that embed and the Tag Manager script every page loads (17 third-party requests measured, 2026-11-21): the page's own resources keep the budgets above.
